caption:
Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 250 g flour
- 2 eggs
- 300 ml buttermilk
- 1 TL baking powder

Instructions:
Whisk the eggs into the buttermilk.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until just combined.
Fry in a buttered pan until golden on both sides.

#pancakes #breakfast
